description:
Activate Evra by paying {4}.
Holding priority, cast Humble by paying {1}{W}, causing Evra to have base power and toughness 0/1 until end of turn.
Resolve Evra's ability, swapping your life total with Evra's power.
Activate Soul of Conduit by paying {6} and tapping it, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero life.
